cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club money was in the other envelope. Please change your committee message from 'missing funds' to 'balance confirmed'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You phoned me crying that the treasurer had stolen it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which is why we must be precise now. State the amount, not the accusation. I'll count it again with you before you send anything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've already asked the treasurer to come in and explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ring them, please. Say there's no need for that meeting; the balance is correct. I'll speak if they have questions about the amount. Questions about the call can wait.
